query: How many countries are members of the United Nations?
answer: The United Nations has 193 member states [1][2]. The last country to join was South Sudan in 2011. Two non-member observer states, the Holy See (Vatican City) and Palestine, can take part in the General Assembly but can't vote [2]. The UN started in 1945 with 51 founding members [2].
